description: Core schema engine and Blogger data layer: SchemaOverride (resolveId + deepMerge), SchemaExtractor (all field extractors), GeoFilter (isServiceable), BloggerConfig, BloggerDataService (decodeEntities, extractJsonLd, fetchPostSchema, resolveAndLoadSchema with cycle detection, toGraphDocument, fetchFeed, fetchPost, extractPostIdFromTagId). Also add http, cached_network_image, geolocator, geocoding to pubspec.yaml.
steps: Add to pubspec.yaml dependencies: http: ^1.2.2, cached_network_image: ^3.4.1, geolocator: ^13.0.2, geocoding: ^3.0.0. Run `flutter pub get`.

Create lib/core/schema/schema_override.dart: class ResolvedId { final String? blogId; final String? postId; final String? url; const ResolvedId({this.blogId, this.postId, this.url}); }. Class SchemaOverride with static ResolvedId resolveId(String base, String idValue) — four-case logic: (1) starts with http:// or https:// -> ResolvedId(url: idValue), (2) split('/') gives exactly 2 non-empty parts -> ResolvedId(blogId: parts[0], postId: parts[1]), (3) base.contains('/') -> ResolvedId(blogId: base.split('/')[0], postId: idValue), (4) else ResolvedId(url: idValue). Static Map<String, dynamic> deepMerge(Map<String,dynamic> target, Map<String,dynamic> source) — iterate source keys: if both target[k] and source[k] are non-null, non-List Maps, recurse; else source wins.

Create lib/core/schema/schema_extractor.dart: static Locale? currentLocale field. Static helpers: getLocalizedValue(dynamic val, Locale? locale) — if val is String return it; if val is List try to find entry whose '@language' matches locale.languageCode, else first string in list; if val is Map return val['@value'] as String?. getFirst(dynamic val) — if List return first element else val. Then extractName, extractDescription, extractImage (first imageObject url or string), extractImages (list), extractPrice (offers->price or price), extractPriceCurrency, extractSku, extractBrand (brand->name), extractVariants (hasVariant list), extractAddons (addOn list), extractAreaServed (areaServed normalized to List<Map>), extractSeller (seller map), extractAdditionalProperties (additionalProperty list), extractStockLevel (availability string). All methods take Map<String,dynamic> schema and return appropriate Dart types (String?, List<Map>, etc.).

Create lib/core/schema/geo_filter.dart: class LocationData placeholder (used across features; real LocationData lives in location_service.dart — import it once that file exists; for now define it here as a simple data class with lat, lon, pin, city, state, country String fields and fromJson/toJson). Class GeoFilter with static bool isServiceable(dynamic areaServed, LocationData location): null/empty -> true. Normalize areaServed to List. For each entry: if @type == 'Country' and name matches location.country -> return true immediately. If @type == 'PostalCode' or postalCode -> match location.pin. If @type == 'City' or 'AdministrativeArea' -> match location.city (case-insensitive). If @type == 'State' -> match location.state. If entry is String -> treat as postal code and match location.pin. Any match -> true. No match after all entries -> false.

Create lib/core/services/blogger_config.dart: enum BloggerAuthMode { unauthenticated, authenticated }. Class BloggerConfig: static const String blogId = String.fromEnvironment('BLOGGER_BLOG_ID', defaultValue: '1774904866501098696'); static BloggerAuthMode get currentAuthMode => BloggerAuthMode.unauthenticated; // TODO: Firebase Auth check. static const String feedBaseUrl = 'https://www.blogger.com/feeds'; static const String v3BaseUrl = 'https://www.googleapis.com/blogger/v3'.

Create lib/core/services/blogger_service.dart importing dart:convert, package:http/http.dart as http, schema_override.dart, blogger_config.dart. Class BloggerDataService: (a) static String decodeEntities(String text) — replace " & ' ' < > [ ]. (b) Map<String,dynamic>? extractJsonLd(String content) — try RegExp r'<script[^>]*type=["']application/ld\+json["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>' to extract group 1, decode entities, strip /* */ comments, JSON.decode; on failure try content.indexOf('{')..lastIndexOf('}') substring fallback. (c) Future<Map<String,dynamic>?> fetchPostSchema({required String blogId, required String postId}) — GET https://www.blogger.com/feeds/$blogId/posts/default/$postId?alt=json, parse JSON, return extractJsonLd(data['entry']['content']['\$t'] ?? ''). (d) Future<Map<String,dynamic>> resolveAndLoadSchema(Map<String,dynamic> schema, {required String base, Set<String>? visited}) — visited ??= {}. Clone schema. Walk every map node recursively. When a node has '@id' String value: call SchemaOverride.resolveId(base, idValue). Build cycle key: blogId+'/'+postId or url. If key in visited skip. Add key to visited. Fetch (fetchPostSchema or http.get for url). If fetched, recurvelyResolve fetched schema with new base, then SchemaOverride.deepMerge(node, fetchedSchema). Remove '@id' from merged to prevent infinite re-resolution. (e) Map<String,dynamic> toGraphDocument(List<Map<String,dynamic>> schemas) — collect @context from all, build unified context Map (merge all @context objects; string @context becomes {'@vocab': value}), strip @context from each node, deduplicate by '@id' (last wins), return {'@context': unifiedCtx, '@graph': dedupedList}. (f) static String? extractPostIdFromTagId(String tagId) — split on '.post-' take last part; return null if pattern not matched. (g) Future<List<Map<String,dynamic>>> fetchFeed({int maxResults = 20, int startIndex = 1, List<String> labels = const [], String? query}) — build URL: base path is feedBaseUrl+'/'+blogId+'/posts/default'; if labels non-empty append '/-/'+labels.join('/'); add query params alt=json, max-results, start-index, and q if query non-null. GET, parse data['feed']['entry'] as List, per entry extract postId via extractPostIdFromTagId from entry['id']['\$t'], alternateUrl from entry['link'] where rel=='alternate', extractJsonLd from entry['content']['\$t']. Return list of non-null schemas. (h) Future<Map<String,dynamic>?> fetchPost({required String postId}) — fetchPostSchema, if non-null resolveAndLoadSchema with base BloggerConfig.blogId+'/'+postId.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze exits 0 with no errors after these files are added
verification: flutter pub get (must succeed after pubspec edits)
findings: Files created: lib/core/schema/schema_override.dart (ResolvedId, SchemaOverride), lib/core/schema/schema_extractor.dart (SchemaExtractor), lib/core/schema/geo_filter.dart (LocationData placeholder + GeoFilter), lib/core/services/blogger_config.dart (BloggerConfig + BloggerAuthMode), lib/core/services/blogger_service.dart (BloggerDataService). pubspec.yaml updated with http:^1.2.2, cached_network_image:^3.4.1, geolocator:^13.0.2, geocoding:^3.0.0. lib/routing/app_router.dart filled in with HomeRoute stub (was a syntax error). All imports use package:http/http.dart. LocationData is defined in lib/core/schema/geo_filter.dart — later features should import from there or replace with the canonical location_service.dart version. BloggerDataService is instantiated (not static) except for decodeEntities and extractPostIdFromTagId which are static.
